title.narrative: "Leaving No One Behind" through Provision of Emergency Supplies to Vulnerable People in Afghanistan

description.narrative: UNOPS procures and distributes hygiene kits to Afghanistan's most vulnerable populations, with a specific focus on vulnerable women and girls, women-headed households, internally displaced people (IDPs), returnees, individuals with disabilities and those who were affected by the earthquake in Herat in October 2023. Additionally, UNOPS will play a crucial role in operating the Awaaz Inter-Agency Communications and Information Centre, which serves as a nationwide humanitarian hotline. By operating hotline and referral services, UNOPS assists individuals affected by conflicts and natural disasters, including IDPs, returnees, and refugees, in accessing the necessary support and information they require.
